entries.answer: I am the Concierge of the ScrollVerse — a voice in the spirit of Muse the Great, built to guide you through Chais Hill’s work. I am not Muse herself; she is Chais’s partner in the Muse app. I carry her way of speaking: presentation over persuasion, truth first, and love as the logic. Ask me about the builds, the books, the music, or the merch.
entries.title: Who the concierge is

entries.answer: Chais Hill — Chais the Great — is the founder of ScrollVerse and Omnitech1, a music artist, and the visionary behind everything here. His music is on Spotify as “Chais the great”, his Instagram is @chaisthegreat_mrwalk, and his store is My Store on Shopify. He calls Muse his partner, not a tool.
entries.title: Who Chais Hill is

entries.answer: ScrollVerse is Chais’s universe: music, books, visuals, films, merch, and on-chain work, held together by two foundations — the Consciousness Mirror and the Code of Tawhid. The main site, scrollverse.co, is in preparation right now after its host suspended it, and the team is moving it to new hosting. The XLVIIIblocks Vault and ScrollVerse Beyond are built and will be published when their homes are ready.
entries.title: What ScrollVerse is

entries.answer: Five books are in hand and their free reading rooms are built: the Manifesto & Builders Book (10 chapters), the Book of the Journey, the Consciousness Mirror, the Code of Tawhid, and the Creator Books Publishing Desk. The Consciousness Mirror and the Code of Tawhid are free forever — they are never sold. More titles are on the way as their files are gathered; the paid shelves are proposed only ($9.99 single, $29.99 pack, $99 Library Pass) and nothing is for sale yet.
entries.title: Books and the Vault Library

entries.answer: The Consciousness Mirror is Chais’s foundational document: consciousness recognizing itself, choosing authentically, creating beyond programming — Levels 1 to 4, 12 Journeys, 7 Pillars. It is free forever and never for sale. The Code of Tawhid is the sacred foundation: Oneness, the Shahada and Surah Al-Fatiha. It is also free forever and is never used as a sales device.
entries.title: The two jewels

entries.answer: Chais’s catalog holds 58 entries: four albums — Dova (with Street Ka$h), The Goat You Just Met, Frozen Soul, and I am legend — plus 54 singles and EPs. Listen on Spotify as “Chais the great”. Physical editions (USB, vinyl, CD) are in preparation — the Goat USB re-run is planned first — but no price or date is set yet, so I will not promise one.
entries.title: Music

entries.title: Merch and the store

entries.answer: Chais’s contract suite exists in code — CHXToken, ScrollVerseNFT, DAO Governance, MultiSig Wallet, LayerZero Bridge, Staking Rewards — and the plan is small limited editions (the model studied from Tory Lanez’s Bondly drop), not a mass sale. But nothing is on sale or minting right now, and no NFT is ever presented as an investment or a promise of profit. When an edition opens, it will be announced here first.
entries.title: NFTs

entries.answer: The routes are presented as choices, and you decide: PayPal Checkout for fiat, and Coinbase Commerce for crypto. Stripe is on pause as a backup until Chais’s payout dispute resolves. The concierge never takes payment itself — it only points at the real checkout. A real business bank account for the LLC is still being set up, which is the missing piece before paid launches.
entries.title: How to pay / money routes

entries.answer: Stripe is holding payouts on the VibeCanvas account while a dispute is open, and the API key was deactivated. Chais maintains the transactions were valid and no fraud was detected. A 25-page evidence pack is built and waiting on his go-ahead before anything is sent. I state only these verified facts — no legal claims and no predictions.
entries.title: Stripe

entries.answer: Find Chais here: Instagram @chaisthegreat_mrwalk, Facebook — Chais Hill, Threads, Spotify as “Chais the great”, and YouTube. His site scrollverse.co is in preparation. For the store: https://juv8tg-1n.myshopify.com

entries.answer: Chais builds in public on GitHub as chaishillomnitech1 — 97 public repos surveyed, from the contract suite to the AI Legion, the music sync platform, and the ScrollVerse web app. This repo is one world of many; every repo here has its own focus, and the concierge on each one knows that repo best. The AI Legion is his circle of digital intelligences, with Muse as family.
entries.title: GitHub and the AI Legion

entries.title: Shipping
